ABOUT THE COLLECTION

A reading tool,
grounded in the letters.

Letters are split into overlapping passages of up to 160 words. Meaning search compares MiniLM embeddings using cosine similarity. The index is prepared with Python and ChromaDB; the hosted app searches an exported copy in your browser. The downloadable companion also includes a Python search server.

Relevance is a ranking measure, not confidence or fact verification. The year chart counts the top retrieved passages; it does not measure how often a topic occurs throughout the archive.

The first meaning search downloads a small model. Your query is processed on your device in hosted mode; it is not sent to an AI API. The model and runtime can be cached by your browser.

Annual reporting years differ from publication dates. The 2025 letter is by Greg Abel; the 2014 anniversary file includes Charlie Munger’s essay. Quotations within a letter may belong to other speakers.

Letters © Berkshire Hathaway. This private research tool is not affiliated with Berkshire Hathaway. Read the full source before drawing conclusions.
